title: String slicing: characters as array indices
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: [0] gets the first character, [1 to -1] gets from index 1 to the last. So for a string `n`, the formula is always upper(n[0]) ++ lower(n[1 to -1]).
